text:
Ava: Quick idea — for the microlaunch next week, instead of cohort-based welcome drips, can we do a signal split (signup source + indicated use-case)?
Sam - growth: Yes please. signals should map to 3 buckets: Integrations, Cost-focused, Platform-eval.
Priya: Agreed. That should let us tailor the 2nd email (benchmark narrative) per group.
Marcos: Do we have the source tag in the signup payload? I think yes for cal pages and docs forms, but not for the product signup.
Ava: @Marcos good point — we can fallback to UTM campaign for product signups. If neither present, default to "general" bucket.
Sam - growth: Draft send plan (rough):
```
Day 0 (immediate): Welcome + quick product tour link
Day 2: Benchmark email (tailored by signal)
Day 5: Webinar invite (relevance-based CTA)
Day 9: Use-case deep-dive + CTA to trial/dedicated demo
```
Priya: For the benchmark email — short one-pager with 3 metrics: latency, cost per 1k tokens, and failover uptime. Keep it non-technical for PMs, with a link to the benchmark repo for engs.
Sam - growth: I'll write two headers: "Why latency matters for user-facing features" and "How to win on cost without losing quality" — one each for Integrations and Cost buckets.
Ava: Webinar planning: can we do 30m demo + 15m Q&A, scheduled one week after launch email? target audience: product + infra buyers.
Marcos: I'll check capacity for demo infra. Also recommend adding a short pre-webinar survey to route people to the right breakout topics.
Priya: Can someone create a small doc with signal mapping + example copy per bucket? link it here.
Sam - growth: Created doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1aBcDEF_example — copy in progress, will ping when ready.
LaunchBot: Reminder set: send final copy for review by 1754322000.
Ava: Nice. Final asks: (1) two subject-line variants per bucket, (2) 1 GIF for product tour, (3) alt copy for accessibility.
Marcos: I'll own the GIF and infra check.
Priya: I'll draft the benchmark one-pager and the webinar agenda.
Sam - growth: Subject tests — Variant A: "See the numbers behind our inference stack" Variant B: "How teams cut inference costs by 3x" — will set A/B.
Ava: Perfect. We'll reconvene here after drafts. :thumbsup:
